about: The ONLY place pin assignments are written. The firmware header and the wiring table are generated from this file.
status: proposed 2026-11-24, not yet wired or tested

board.name: ESP32-C3 SuperMini
board.avoid: GPIO2, GPIO8 and GPIO9 are boot-strapping pins (GPIO8 is also the on-board LED); GPIO18/19 are USB

wires: 7 wires, about 80 mm each: from the display's tab, through the slot in the cover and hanger, under the saddle, up the back wall to the board
